items.title: Universal injectivity of the map to the adic completion under a condition on associated primes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that under a condition on the associated primes of the tensor products with finite modules, the map from a finite module into its adic completion is universally injective over the base (statement lines 2059-2075, tag 05DL). The proof reduces the universal injectivity to injectivity, then to the vanishing of the localisations of the kernel at the associated primes of the module, and finally uses the hypothesis to find a prime containing the extended ideal and the associated prime, where the intersection of the powers of the ideal vanishes by the corresponding statement for modules. The reduction to the associated primes is the substance, so the claim is H2.
